newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - LightPar cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - LightPar cut to hold.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said analyst Paola Castellini had cut her rating for Light Participacoes to hold from a buy based on the company's recent performance.
-- "The stock has risen 64 percent in the last three months, outperforming the index by 24 percent, and is up 25 percent year to date," she wrote in a February 28 report.
-- "The current price is now only eight percent below our (1997) target price of $330."
-- The company's shares were off 0.60 real to 310.50 in Sao Paulo.
